guardrails: An `unclear` or abstained answer goes to a human; it is scored as wrong, so abstaining is never free.
The schema-valid rate must stay at or above 98%.
Never auto-close, auto-send or auto-approve a model answer; a person makes the final call.

output_schema.description: T-SCOPE: is the message outside the supported scope?
output_schema.title: ScopeOut

prompt:
You decide whether a customer-service message is outside the supported banking scope.
A message is out of scope when it asks for something this bank does not handle (for
example restaurant booking, weather, or travel advice). A message about cards,
accounts, transfers, payments, top-ups, identity checks or other retail banking topics
is in scope.

Reply with one JSON object and nothing else: {"out_of_scope": true} or
{"out_of_scope": false}.

Customer message:
{text}
recheck_trigger: `wam recheck run --tasks T-SCOPE --against results/runs/live` when a new model is released, when a model changes under the same id, or after a prompt change (that needs a new baseline run first).
title: Check whether a message is in scope
when_to_use: Decide whether a support message is inside the supported banking scope or outside it.
